correctness.rationale: For I_n the undirected untyped incidence graph of K_n (singletons and 2-subsets, no order/sorts), standard rank-q EF equivalence is captured EXACTLY by nested extension-type sets T_{q+1}(a)=(atomic(a),{T_q(a,b):b vertex}) with repetitions discarded. Permutations of unused underlying labels give a complete orbit-representative extension list (old singleton/pair, old+new, new+new). Independently constructed immutable recursive types for n=1..8 and q=1..5; got cutoffs 1,3,4,5,7 and verified the q=5 n7=n8 equality, with 105719 unique (n,tuple,depth) states. The source C++/Python exact recurrence supports n<=10; the support-preserving partial bijection for both n>=2q gives infinite-tail EF equivalence, and finite bridges between cutoff and 2q prove all n. No mere extrapolation of n<=10 is used. Rank-five sharp representative order is 7+binom(7,2)=28, only within this family.
